explanation: Potter first told the Peter Rabbit story in an illustrated letter to a sick child in 1893. Earnings from her books helped her buy Lake District farms, which she left to the National Trust.

claims.text: Beatrix Potter wrote and illustrated The Tale of Peter Rabbit.
Enid Blyton, Kenneth Grahame and A. A. Milne did not create Peter Rabbit.
Potter first told the Peter Rabbit story in an illustrated letter to Noel Moore, a sick child, in 1893.
Earnings from her books helped Potter buy farmland in the Lake District, which she left to the National Trust.
